action_items: Review the two small UI fixes I applied to unblock testing: (1) Layout.jsx NotifBell dropdown class changed from 'fixed left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 top-20 ...' to 'fixed left-0 right-0 mx-auto top-20 ...' because fade-up animation's transform:none end-state cancelled the -translate-x-1/2. Consider a cleaner solution: remove fade-up from the dropdown or change fade-up @keyframes to leave transform alone (only opacity). (2) CoachChat.jsx overlay z-50 -> z-[60] because bottom-nav (z-50) rendered on top and blocked coach-input/coach-send on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: fade-up class has animation-fill-mode:both with transform:none end-state — any element using fade-up together with a Tailwind translate/scale utility will silently lose that transform. Consider changing fade-up @keyframes to animate only opacity (or opacity+filter) and drop the translateY, OR add a separate .fade-up-y class that keeps transform-friendly components decoupled.

Z-index stacking is fragile: bottom-nav z-50, coach overlay was z-50, NotifBell overlay backdrop z-40 with dropdown z-50, receipt Dialog z-50. Recommend centralising a z-index scale token (e.g. z-nav=50, z-modal=60, z-toast=70).

Orientation lock only blocks screen<=900px landscape via CSS; it will NOT trigger on tablets in landscape wider than 900 (e.g., 1024x768 iPad landscape shows nothing). If the intent is 'no landscape on any device up to tablet', raise breakpoint to 1200 or (max-height: 500px) OR check aspect-ratio.

rca of the issue: Notification dropdown was previously reported to shift the page on mobile. E1's fix applied `-translate-x-1/2` for centering but the same element carries the `fade-up` utility class whose @keyframes ends with `transform: none` and `animation-fill-mode: both`, which forcibly clears the tailwind translate at the end of the 0.5s animation. Result: box.x = 50% viewport (195px on 390-wide), then bento contents extending 358px right, going off-screen and causing perceived shift. Verified pre-fix: notif-list x=195, w=358.8, center=374 (bad). Post-fix (mx-auto): x=15.6, center=195 (correct).
